questions.stem: What is the name of the theorem that states every composite number can be expressed as a product of primes in a unique way?
questions.solution: The theorem is called the Fundamental Theorem of Arithmetic. It states that every composite number can be expressed as a product of primes in a unique way. The other options are not the correct names of the theorem.

questions.stem: What is the method of finding HCF and LCM of two numbers by breaking them into prime factors called?
questions.solution: The correct method for finding the HCF and LCM of two numbers by breaking them into prime factors is called the prime factorisation method. This involves expressing each number as a product of its prime factors and then using those to determine the highest common factor and least common multiple. The other options do not specifically refer to the process of breaking numbers into prime factors.

questions.stem: What is the HCF of 6, 72, and 120 using the prime factorisation method?
questions.solution: To find the HCF using prime factorisation, identify the common prime factors with the smallest powers. The prime factors of 6, 72, and 120 are 2 and 3, each appearing at least once. Multiplying these gives 2 × 3 = 6. The other options either include extra factors or use higher powers that are not common to all numbers.

questions.stem: Why is the number 7 × 11 × 13 + 13 a composite number?
questions.solution: The expression 7 × 11 × 13 + 13 can be factored as 13 × (7 × 11 + 1), which equals 13 × 78. Since 13 is a factor of the number, it is divisible by 13, making it a composite number. The number is not divisible by 2, 7, or 11 because the factors of the resulting product do not include these numbers.

mr.solution: समीकरण 7 × 11 × 13 + 13 ला 13 × (7 × 11 + 1) च्या रूपात घटक केले जाऊ शकते, जे 13 × 78 च्या बरोबर आहे. 13 हा संख्येचा घटक असल्याने, ती 13 ने भाज्य आहे, ज्यामुळे ती एक घटनात्मक संख्या बनते. उत्पादनाच्या घटकांमध्ये हे संख्या 2, 7 किंवा 11 नाहीत, म्हणून ती त्यांना भाज्य नाहीत.
